name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-22 STATE-ENGINE CRASH-SAFETY (OBJECT.VALUES NORMALIZATION): The app crashed immediately at boot/hydration with 'TypeError: Cannot convert undefined or null to object ... at Object.values ... at Array.filter' whenever a snapshot/SSE/localStorage payload carried a null, undefined or object-map-shaped collection (e.g. { branches: null } or { stores: {...} }) — stockItems low-stock filtering and other render paths called Object.values() directly on raw collection fields. Fixes: (1) NEW global state helpers module src/utils/stateHelpers.ts exporting safeArray/safeObjectValues/safeObjectKeys/normalizeDbCollections plus a single canonical COLLECTION_KEYS list; (2) the state engine in applyData now runs every incoming payload through normalizeDbCollections before writing dbStateRef.current and before applyCollectionState dispatches React setters, so ALL collections are hard-guaranteed plain arrays (object-maps unwrapped, null/undefined/primitives -> []) while every non-collection key (settings/_version/_assembled/lastUpdated) is preserved verbatim; (3) normalizeDbCollections also applied to the initPhpSync boot reconciliation overlay; (4) all raw Object.values() call sites hardened to safeObjectValues — stockItems low-stock filter (the reported crash), ALL_CORE_PAGES rolePermissions flattener, AICopilot stock aggregation (2 sites), PredictiveForecasting stock valuation; (5) sanitizeStateData now shares the canonical COLLECTION_KEYS import. Acceptance: app must mount cleanly even when the API returns { branches: null } / { stores: {} } / { categories: undefined } etc., render all panels without the Object.values TypeError, and survive stale localStorage/SSE payloads from older builds.
